lines.text: Britain built a 2,500-mile barrier across India. Then forgot it.

parts.tts: Britain built a two thousand five hundred-mile barrier across India. Then forgot it.
parts.heard: Britain built a 2,500-mile barrier across India, then forgot it.

lines.text: British-ruled India, the 1800s. The goal? Taxing salt.

parts.tts: British-ruled India, the eighteen hundreds. The goal? Taxing salt.
parts.heard: British ruled India, the 1800s. The goal, taxing salt.

lines.text: To stop salt smugglers, they built a customs line about 2,500 miles long.

parts.tts: To stop salt smugglers, they built a customs line about two thousand five hundred miles long.
parts.heard: To stop salt smugglers, they built a customs line about 2,500 miles long.

lines.text: Hundreds of miles of it was a living hedge of thorny bushes, up to 12 feet high.

parts.tts: Hundreds of miles of it was a living hedge of thorny bushes, up to twelve feet high.
parts.heard: Hundreds of miles of it was a living hedge of thorny bushes, up to 12 feet high.

lines.text: People compared it to the Great Wall of China.

parts.tts: People compared it to the Great Wall of China.
parts.heard: People compared it to the Great Wall of China.

lines.text: At its peak, in 1872, more than 14,000 men guarded it.

parts.tts: At its peak, in eighteen seventy-two, more than fourteen thousand men guarded it.
parts.heard: At its peak, in 1872, more than 14,000 men guarded it.

lines.text: In 1879, it was abandoned. And it was forgotten so completely, standard histories skipped it.

parts.tts: In eighteen seventy-nine, it was abandoned. And it was forgotten so completely, standard histories skipped it.
parts.heard: In 1879, it was abandoned, and it was forgotten so completely, standard histories skipped it.

lines.text: In the 1990s, a London library conservator made three trips to India just to find it.

parts.tts: In the nineteen ninetys, a London library conservator made three trips to India just to find it.
parts.heard: In the 1990s, a London library conservator made three trips to India just to find it.

lines.text: What he found: one small raised embankment. It may be all that's left.

parts.tts: What he found: one small raised embankment. It may be all that's left.
parts.heard: what he found, one small raised embankment. It may be all that's left.
